## Actions

| Action | Description | Requires |

| `delete_selected` | `Delete selected reviews` | delete |

REST: `POST library/review/actions/delete_selected/` with `{"pks": ["1", "2"]}`.
MCP: `django-admin:admin.action` with `{"app_label": "library", "model_name": "review", "action_name": "delete_selected", "pks": ["1"]}`.
`delete_selected` deletes every selected object; it needs `"confirmed": true` (REST body) and the user's explicit yes first.
An action's descriptor in the list response says `target: batch` (one or more pks) or `target: detail` (exactly one pk).
